Mariya Takeuchi.bio: Pioneer of 1980s Japanese City Pop whose collaboration with Tatsuro Yamashita defined the nocturnal Tokyo slap-bass and Rhodes synth-funk aesthetic.
Mariya Takeuchi.signature_sound: slap bass, Fender Rhodes, lush brass section, 80s analog synth strings
Mariya Takeuchi.recommended_moments: late-night highway drives, upbeat evening groove, retro 80s nostalgia

Taeko Ohnuki.bio: Acclaimed Japanese singer-songwriter blending jazz-inflected City Pop sophistication with cinematic nocturnal arrangements.
Taeko Ohnuki.signature_sound: warm electric piano, sweeping strings, moody nocturnal synth pads
Taeko Ohnuki.recommended_moments: 4:00 A.M. rainy night reflection, late-night city walks, atmospheric listening

Miki Matsubara.bio: Iconic Japanese City Pop vocalist celebrated for fusing jazz-funk horn sections with soaring melodic hooks.
Miki Matsubara.signature_sound: disco-funk basslines, brass stabs, electric guitar solos, upbeat groove
Miki Matsubara.recommended_moments: energetic night drives, feel-good upbeat sessions, retro party vibes

Sade Adu.bio: Frontwoman of Sade and the defining voice of sophisti-pop, merging cool jazz saxophone, brushed percussion, and velvet soul-pop.
Sade Adu.signature_sound: tenor saxophone, brushed snare, warm bass, understated electric piano
Sade Adu.recommended_moments: pomodoro study blocks, late-night coding, espresso lounge reading, date night

Grover Washington, Jr..bio: Foundational smooth jazz and soul-jazz saxophonist renowned for warm Fender Rhodes and lyrical horn interplay.
Grover Washington, Jr..signature_sound: soprano and tenor saxophone, Fender Rhodes electric piano, rain-like percussion
Grover Washington, Jr..recommended_moments: Sunday morning coffee, rainy windowpane focus, romantic evening unwinding

Sabin Rai.bio: Legendary Nepali pop-rock singer-songwriter known for emotive raspy vocals, unplugged acoustic guitar balladry, and timeless Himalayan anthems.
Sabin Rai.signature_sound: unplugged acoustic guitar, soulful rock vocals, melodic folk-rock phrasing
Sabin Rai.recommended_moments: nostalgic evening listening, acoustic reflection, campfire singalongs

Bipul Chettri.bio: Himalayan folk-indie singer-songwriter who weaves traditional Nepali पहाडी (hill) melodies with intimate fingerpicked acoustic guitar.
Bipul Chettri.signature_sound: fingerstyle acoustic guitar, resonant cello, mountain folk storytelling
Bipul Chettri.recommended_moments: peaceful study sessions, rainy night coding, calm meditation, travel

Pahenlo Batti Muni.bio: Introspective Kathmandu alternative/indie band crafting deeply poetic, melancholic, and existential Nepali rock ballads.
Pahenlo Batti Muni.signature_sound: clean reverberant guitar, somber basslines, philosophical Nepali lyricism
Pahenlo Batti Muni.recommended_moments: late-night existential introspection, quiet solitude, melancholic catharsis

VZN.bio: High-energy Nepali hip-hop/R&B hitmaker delivering infectious festival bounce, driving 808 percussion, and hype party anthems.
VZN.signature_sound: punchy 808 bass, modern trap-pop percussion, high-cadence vocal hooks
VZN.recommended_moments: peak gym workouts, cardio sprints, pre-game hype, festive parties

The Local Train.bio: Acclaimed Hindi indie rock band blending raw acoustic guitar strumming with soaring, emotionally charged Urdu/Hindi poetry.
The Local Train.signature_sound: acoustic-electric guitar crescendos, heartfelt Hindi rock vocals, warm bass
The Local Train.recommended_moments: late-night heartache, nostalgic long drives, soulful acoustic listening

Pritam.bio: Prolific Indian composer blending Sufi folk, acoustic guitar, and lush contemporary Bollywood romance.
Pritam.signature_sound: acoustic guitar, warm orchestral strings, soulful Sufi-pop melodies
Pritam.recommended_moments: romantic evenings, peaceful unwinding, nostalgic Hindi melody sessions

activity_guides.title: Cognitive Flow & Coding Acoustics Guide
activity_guides.insight: Psychoacoustic research shows that tracks between 70–96 BPM with high acoustic warmth (fingerpicked guitar, Fender Rhodes, or velvet saxophone like Bipul Chettri and Sade Adu) maintain steady cognitive flow during coding and debugging.

activity_guides.title: Night Drive & 80s Japanese City Pop Guide
activity_guides.insight: Steady 105–122 BPM slap-bass grooves and lush Rhodes synth-brass chords (Mariya Takeuchi, Miki Matsubara, Anri) provide rhythmic optic-flow synchronization ideal for nocturnal highway drives.

activity_guides.title: Peak Workout & Nepali Hype Cadence Guide
activity_guides.insight: Tracks with energy above 0.80 and tempos between 120–145 BPM (VZN, Jamesy, PURPLE) synchronize with running stride cadence and recruit motor-cortex arousal during heavy workouts.

activity_guides.title: Late-Night Introspection & Acoustic Catharsis Guide
activity_guides.insight: Low-valence, high-acousticness arrangements (Pahenlo Batti Muni's Gauthali, The Local Train's Choo Lo, and Bipul Chettri's Deorali Darah) support emotional catharsis and quiet midnight reflection.
